inspectionGroups.notes: The rear case, DIN clip and side mounting rails follow their native CAD seats. The estimated PCB and the native side inserts retain their shared interior positions. The distance provides viewing clearance.

The front panel, button bank and fitted display lift clear of the three side inserts. The inserts match the locations in the Station-Bat source assembly, so this view keeps them fixed with the estimated board space.
